title: [question] Releases to f-droid?
symptom: The user asks why AndroidAPS is not released on F-Droid, suggesting it could increase popularity and provide easier updates via notifications.
cause: The maintainers state that the app is not provided on Google Play or F-Droid for legal reasons, likely due to medical device regulations and liability concerns.
evidence_quote: The app is not provided in Google Play - you have to build it from source code by yourself for legal reasons.
